decisionBoard.title: Most business owners who come to me are in one of these situations.
decisionBoard.summary: Either you don't have a website and nothing solid to send an interested customer, or you have one that no longer reflects the business you run today. Either way, the first step is the same: work out what your customer needs to hear before they get in touch.
decisionBoard.label: Is this you?

servicesSection.label: What I build
servicesSection.title: One page or a full website? It depends on the business.

servicesSection.scopeNote: These are starting prices. The final price depends on the scope and is set out clearly before we begin. Payment is split into three parts: 50% upfront, 30% when the design is approved and 20% before launch.
servicesSection.aftercareNote: Once the site is live, you can still come to me for small updates and ongoing maintenance.
servicesSection.helperQuestion: Not sure which one you need?

process.label: How it works
title: From your first message
to a live website.
process.text: Four simple steps. You always know what's happening, and we don't move forward until you've approved each stage.
process.ctaText: Want to know what this could look like for your business?

items.title: A quick chat
items.text: You tell me, in plain language, what the business does, who your customers are and what you want people to do when they visit the site. From that, I work out what the site needs to say and in what order.

items.title: I write the copy
items.text: I take what you've told me, organise it and write all the copy for the site. You read it, make any corrections and approve it.

items.title: Custom design
items.text: Once the copy is approved, I design the site around it. No off-the-shelf template — a design that actually feels like your business.

items.title: Build and launch
items.text: I build the site, test it on phones and computers, and put it live. You get a finished website that works properly.

about.label: Who's behind it
about.title: I'm Pini. I handle everything myself.
paragraphs: I work on every site myself, from the first conversation and the copy and design all the way through to launch.
When the same person listens, writes and designs, nothing gets lost along the way. You don't have to explain the same thing three times to three different people.
I take on no more than two projects at a time, so each one gets the attention it deserves.

strengths.title: One person from start to finish
strengths.text: You deal with me directly — no team and no project manager in the middle.

strengths.title: Plain, human language
strengths.text: I write so your customers understand. No jargon and no fluff.

strengths.title: Design that fits your business
strengths.text: Not a ready-made template with different colours. A design built for you.

strengths.title: A clear price upfront
strengths.text: You know what it costs before we start. No surprises halfway through.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions people usually ask
faq.text: The things business owners tend to ask before making a decision.
faq.contactText: Got a question that isn't here?

items.question: What kind of website does my business need?
items.answer: A landing page is best when you're promoting one service or offer. A one-page website works when everything a customer needs to know can fit comfortably on one page. A full website makes sense when you offer several different services and each one needs its own explanation. I'll help you choose the right option for your business.

items.question: How much does a small-business website cost?
items.answer: Landing pages start at ₪2,900, one-page websites at ₪3,900 and full websites at ₪6,900. The final price depends on the size and complexity, and includes learning about your business, writing the copy, design, development and mobile optimisation. You'll get the full scope and final price before we begin.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Around one week for a landing page, about 10 days for a one-page website and up to three weeks for a full website. The clock starts after the first payment and doesn't include time spent waiting for your feedback.

items.question: Will my website show up on Google?
items.answer: Yes. Every site I build launches with the basics Google needs: a clear structure, copy based on what your customers actually search for, fast loading, mobile optimisation and Google indexing. To be clear, appearing on Google isn't the same as ranking first. Reaching the top in a competitive field usually takes ongoing SEO, which is a separate service. What I do promise is a website built on the right foundation from day one.

items.question: Do I need to bring finished copy or content?
items.answer: No. I write all the copy. If you already have useful material, we'll use it as a starting point. You just need to tell me about the business and approve what I write.

items.question: How many rounds of changes are included?
items.answer: We review the copy and design, make the agreed changes and only move forward once you've approved each stage. The exact number of revision rounds depends on the project and is written clearly in the proposal before we begin.

items.question: What if I don't like the result?
items.answer: That rarely happens because nothing moves forward without your approval. You review the copy before the design begins, and approve the design before I build the site. If something doesn't feel right, we talk about it, fix it and only then move on. There shouldn't be any surprise at the end.

items.question: What happens after the website goes live?
items.answer: You can still come to me for small updates and ongoing maintenance after launch.

finalCta.title: Want to talk about your website?
finalCta.text: Send me a quick message with what your business does and what's missing. I'll come back with a straight answer: what I recommend, what it costs and how long it takes. And if a website isn't what your business needs right now, I'll tell you that too.

nichePages.metaTitle: Websites for Beauty and Skincare Clinics | NorthSpark Studio
nichePages.metaDescription: A website for your beauty clinic or skincare business, with clear treatment pages, easy booking and a design that builds trust. Copy, design and development by one person.
nichePages.eyebrow: Websites for beauty and skincare businesses
nichePages.title: Your clinic's website should start selling before a customer even calls
nichePages.intro: Most beauty clients decide where to book before they ever pick up the phone. They check Instagram, Google the business and look for a reason to trust it. A good website gives them one: it explains each treatment, shows the real clinic and makes booking simple.

painPoints.title: Every treatment needs its own explanation
painPoints.text: Someone choosing between treatments wants to know what's involved, how long it takes and whether it's right for them. An Instagram photo can't answer all that.

painPoints.title: Booking should be easy
painPoints.text: No hunting for a phone number between posts. A clear WhatsApp or call button is always within reach.

painPoints.title: Build trust before they arrive
painPoints.text: Real photos and a clear introduction to the clinic and the person behind it turn a curious visitor into someone ready to book.

nichePages.metaTitle: Websites for Plumbers, Electricians and Tradespeople | NorthSpark Studio
nichePages.metaDescription: Websites for plumbers, electricians and tradespeople, with real work, quick contact and trust before the first call. Copy, design and development by one person.
nichePages.title: When customers need a tradesperson, they're usually checking a few at once
nichePages.intro: Someone looking for a plumber, electrician or contractor will often contact several people at the same time. The first one to respond with something professional and trustworthy has a real advantage. A website that shows your work and makes it easy to call can be what wins the job.

painPoints.title: You're not the only person they're checking
painPoints.text: A website with real work and solid proof can help you win the job before a competitor even answers the phone.

painPoints.title: People need to see your work
painPoints.text: Show them jobs you've actually completed, not just word-of-mouth recommendations. People want to see before they trust.

painPoints.title: Make it easy to call from a phone
painPoints.text: A clear call or WhatsApp button, with no forms and no searching for your number.

nichePages.metaTitle: Donation Pages for Nonprofits | NorthSpark Studio
nichePages.metaDescription: A nonprofit donation page that explains why the work matters and lets people donate without leaving the page. Copy, design and development by one person.
nichePages.title: Once someone decides to donate, every extra step makes them less likely to finish
nichePages.intro: A good donation page doesn't send people somewhere else or leave them with unanswered questions. It quickly explains where the money goes and why it matters, then lets them donate right there on the page.

painPoints.title: Donating should be simple
painPoints.text: Let people donate on the same page, without jumping between screens or filling out a long, awkward form.

painPoints.title: People give when they understand why
painPoints.text: Explain clearly where the money goes and why it matters. A donation button on its own isn't enough.

painPoints.title: Trust is everything
painPoints.text: Real photos and honest information matter. A generic-looking page can make a potential donor hesitate.
